title: Doc Edgerton, EG&G and filming the Manhattan Project

tellings.quote: Edertton had developed a revolutionary use of stroboscopic cameras that along with other pioneering wartime technology ended up being used in the Manhattan project.

plain: An MIT engineer named Harold "Doc" Edgerton is said to have found a new use for stroboscopic cameras, which use very fast flashes of light to freeze motion. According to the story, this camera work and other new wartime technology ended up being used in the Manhattan Project, the US wartime effort to build the atomic bomb. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as background to a story about a secret hangar.
